aula.objetivo: Form the instrumental in the singular and plural and use it for «with», instruments, professions, seasons of the year and the prepositions of place.

blocos.titulo: Support tables and verbs with the instrumental
blocos.explicacao: Support tables: plural, adjectives and possessives in the instrumental. Verbs that take the instrumental. Some verbs always take the instrumental. Here are the main ones. Watch the verb быть: in the past and the future it usually takes the instrumental for what someone is. This is one of the most important rules. Notice: быть in the past or future puts the predicate (what the person is) in the instrumental. But быть does not exist in the present (you know that from Lesson 4), so in the present the predicate stays in the nominative: Я студе́нт. (I am a student: no verb, nominative.) Я был студе́нтом. (I was a student: with the verb, instrumental.) English has no case here at all, so the thing to memorise is simply the pattern: was / will be / became + instrumental.

tabelas.titulo: Support tables: plural, adjectives and possessives in the instrumental

linhas.POSSESSIVOS E DEMONSTRATIVOS: с мои́м, твои́м, на́шим, ва́шим, э́тим
linhas.FULL EXAMPLE: ко́фе с горя́чим молоко́м · с мои́м дру́гом

linhas.POSSESSIVOS E DEMONSTRATIVOS: с мое́й, твое́й, на́шей, ва́шей, э́той
с мои́ми, твои́ми, на́шими, ва́шими, э́тими

linhas.EXAMPLE: Я был студе́нтом. (I was a student.)
Он стал врачо́м. (He became a doctor.)
Э́то называ́ется по́-ру́сски. (This is called that in Russian.)

linhas.TRANSLATION: to be busy with, to study
linhas.EXAMPLE: Я занима́юсь ру́сским языко́м. (I study Russian.)
Я интересую́сь исто́рией. (I am interested in history.)

linhas.TRANSLATION: to own, to have a command of
linhas.EXAMPLE: Он владе́ет ру́сским. (He has a command of Russian.)
Я дово́лен результа́том. (I am satisfied with the result.)
Я за́нят рабо́той. (I am busy with work.)

blocos.explicacao: The idiom мы с X. This is one of the most elegant constructions in Russian. When Russian wants to say "X and I", it says "we with X". How to use it: the subject is always мы (we), even when the group is only two people, and the verb is plural. The «с» + instrumental names the other person. Notice what English does: "Eva and I" lists two people with "and". Russian says "we, together with Eva". In place of "my husband and I", Russian says "we with the husband". It is used all the time in daily life.

linhas.RUSSIAN: Мы с Е́вой реши́ли пое́хать в Сиби́рь.
linhas.TRANSLATION: Eva and I decided to go to Siberia.

linhas.RUSSIAN: Мы с му́жем живём в Москве́.
linhas.TRANSLATION: My husband and I live in Moscow.

linhas.RUSSIAN: Мы с дру́гом идём в кино́.
linhas.TRANSLATION: My friend and I are going to the movies.

blocos.explicacao: The instrumental of time. Some time expressions use the instrumental with no preposition. You have seen this in passing with the prepositional; this is the right place for it. Notice that these adverbs are really instrumental forms of nouns (у́тро → у́тром, день → днём, ве́чер → ве́чером, ночь → но́чью). That is why they count as instrumental. But you do not need to think about that, you only need to use them. English does the same job with "in the" or with no word at all ("mornings", "in summer").

linhas.TRANSLATION: In the morning I drink coffee.

blocos.titulo: Common mistakes, sentences and summary of the instrumental
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: The mistakes English speakers WILL make with the instrumental. Mistake 1: using С when it is not needed. Wrong: Я пишу́ с ру́чкой. Right: Я пишу́ ру́чкой. You think "with a pen" and translate it as «с ручкой». But the pen is an extension of the hand, so there is no С: bare instrumental. Mistake 2: leaving out С when it is needed. Wrong: Я иду́ дру́гом. Right: Я иду́ с дру́гом. The friend is another person, not an extension of your body, so С is needed. Mistake 3: using С with tools. Wrong: Я ем суп с ло́жкой. Right: Я ем суп ло́жкой. The spoon is an extension of the hand: bare instrumental. Mistake 4: forgetting that ПОД and ЗА change case. Wrong: Кот под стол (meaning "the cat is under the table"). Right: Кот под столо́м. Place = instrumental. Movement = accusative. Mistake 5: forgetting the С / СО variation. Wrong: Он идёт с мной. Right: Он идёт со мной. Mistake 6: leaving out н- after a preposition. Wrong: Я иду́ с им. Right: Я иду́ с ним. After a preposition, он becomes ним (with н). Mistake 7: not using the instrumental with быть in the past or future. Wrong: Я был студе́нт. Right: Я был студе́нтом. Быть in the past usually puts the predicate in the instrumental. Mistake 8: mixing up быть in the present (nominative) with быть in the past (instrumental). Wrong: Я студе́нтом. (in the present) Right: Я студе́нт (nominative: present). Я был студе́нтом (instrumental: past). Быть does not exist in the present, so the predicate stays in the nominative; only in the past and the future does it go into the instrumental. Mistake 9: forgetting that МЕ́ЖДУ takes the instrumental. Wrong: Ме́жду стол и дива́н. Right: Ме́жду столо́м и дива́ном. Ме́жду takes the instrumental on both sides. Mistake 10: leaving the noun in the nominative where an instrument ending is needed. Wrong: Я пишу́ ру́чка. Right: Я пишу́ ру́чкой. Masculine and neuter: -ОМ/-ЕМ. Feminine in -а: -ОЙ. Feminine in -ь: -ЬЮ. STEP 2: Full sentences with the instrumental. Here are real sentences, so you can see the instrumental at work. STEP 3: Summary table: the instrumental case.

linhas.TRANSLATION: I eat soup with a spoon.
Cut the bread with a knife.
The cat is under the table.
The lamp is above the table.
The house is behind the garden.
In front of the house there are trees.
Between the table and the sofa — the lamp.

linhas.RUSSIAN: Мы с Е́вой идём в кино́.
linhas.TRANSLATION: Eva and I are going to the movies.
In the morning I drink coffee.

blocos.titulo: С кем ты работаешь? / Who do you work with?

linhas.pt: — What do you do for a living, Andrei?
— I work as an engineer. And you?

linhas.ru: — Я работаю врачом. Я работаю с детьми.
linhas.pt: — I work as a doctor. I work with children.
linhas.audio: Я работаю врачом. Я работаю с детьми.

linhas.ru: — Да, очень! А летом я езжу с семьёй на море.
linhas.pt: — Yes, very much! And in summer I go with my family to the beach.
linhas.audio: Да, очень! А летом я езжу с семьёй на море.

linhas.ru: — Хорошо! А я зимой хожу с друзьями в горы.
linhas.pt: — Great! And in winter I go with friends to the mountains.
linhas.audio: Хорошо! А я зимой хожу с друзьями в горы.

linhas.ru: — Отлично! Зимой холодно, но это интересно!
linhas.pt: — Excellent! It's cold in winter, but it's interesting!
linhas.audio: Отлично! Зимой холодно, но это интересно!

blocos.titulo: Лето с семьёй / Summer with the family
blocos.ru: Летом мы с семьёй едем на море. Я еду с мамой, с папой и с братом. Мы живём рядом с морем. Утром мы гуляем с собакой, днём отдыхаем, а вечером ужинаем с друзьями. Мне очень нравится лето!
blocos.pt: In summer we go with the family to the beach. I go with my mother, my father and my brother. We live near the sea. In the morning we walk the dog, during the day we rest and in the evening we have dinner with friends. I like summer a lot!

perguntas.pergunta: С кем автор едет на море?
perguntas.resposta: С мамой, с папой и с братом

blocos.enunciado: Tell what you do in summer and with whom.
